pages.title: Supply Crate
pages.text: Stocked crates wait at ORSA camps, cargo drops, evac wrecks, blast pits and monitoring stations.$(br2)Look for $(l:orsa_equipment/o2_canisters)Rebreather Cartridges$(/l). Mined, a crate works like a barrel.

pages.title: Field Radio
pages.text: Use the radio at a camp. About $(bold)1 in 3$() still works and reads out the nearest Communication Tower.$(br2)Smoking radios are dead: static only.

pages.title: Alarm Beacon
pages.text: Town alarms spin and blare through $(bold)Phase 4$(), then fall silent.$(br2)They can't be taken.

pages.title: Street Light
pages.text: Flickers on town streets through $(bold)Phase 4$(), then goes dark.$(br2)Mine it to keep. It stands on a solid block or iron bars.
